task.question: On what date in September 2026 did Katalyst Space’s LINK spacecraft re-enter Earth’s atmosphere after its unsuccessful Swift orbit-boost mission?
task.evidence: The spacecraft re-entered the atmosphere on Sept. 25.
task.page: NASA Highlights Lessons Learned From Swift Boost Mission

answer:
The Katalyst Space’s LINK spacecraft re-entered Earth’s atmosphere on September 11, 2026, after its unsuccessful Swift orbit-boost mission. 

FINAL: September 11, 2026
